item.title: On 13 acres in Arkansas! Nice interior! C. 1908. $164,900
item.description: This has a nice interior! Nice acreage too! The house was built in 1908. It is located on 13 acres in Williford, Arkansas. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, log walls, corner cabinet and crown moulding. There are a couple of outbuildings and a carport for an RV. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,008 square feet. $164,900 Contact J. item.title: Storybook cottage! Circa 1938 in California. $299,000
item.description: This looks like a storybook cottage! It has character! The house was built in 1938. It is located in Twin Peaks, California. The house features nice landscaping, knotty pine, exposed beams, wainscoting and a stone fireplace. It has a private backyard. There is a large deck area and storage. item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1853. One acre in North Carolina. $388,000
item.description: This house has some pretty features! Love the upper porch area. The house was built in 1853. It is located on one acre in Greenville, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, upper porch, screened in back porch, beautiful crown moulding, wood floors, wide baseboards, chair rails, gorgeous crystal chandeliers, spacious kitchen and large bedrooms. item.description: This would make such a great vacation spot! So many outdoor activities nearby! This is the type of house where you could move into it and work room by room. item.title: Love this! Beautiful area! Circa 1797 in Virginia. $369,900
item.description: Love this house! It’s a really pretty area and not far from us in Saltville, Virginia. There is a lot of history with this house! It was originally built by Thomas Berry, a Revolutionary War veteran who was commissioned to survey the “Great Road” from Watauga to the ford of the South Holston River. The Buchanan Litz House was built in 1797. It is located on 1.18 acres in Meadowview, Virginia. item.title: Stove is beautiful! Nice cabin in Colorado. Circa 1905. $389,000
item.description: That sure is a beautiful stove in this house! Pretty setting! The cabin is being sold fully furnished. The house was built in 1905. It is located on .41 acre in Pine, Colorado. The house features a large deck, wood floors, log walls, vaulted ceiling, knotty pine, claw foot tub, raised bed platform and a unique soaking tub. There is a detached storage unit on the property. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,234 square feet. $389,000 Contact Lisa Keener with Coldwell Banker Global Luxury Denver: 72

item.title: Pretty church! Circa 1880. Over an acre in Connecticut. $113,000
item.description: This is a pretty church! Love the exterior! The church was built in 1880. It is located on 1.4 acres in Griswold, Connecticut. The church is up on a elevated hill and is close to a local pond with public access. There are lots of possibilities. I love the stone retaining wall. The church is 1,872 square feet. $113,000 Contact Tanzania Stephens with Real Broker: 860-463-2748 From the Zillow listing: Step inside this historic 1880 church located in Griswold, offering 1,872 square feet of interior

item.title: Porch goals! Nice bathrooms! Pretty interior! C. 1910 in Florida. $350,000
item.description: This house is really pretty! Love the bathrooms and the interior! The porch is really nice too. The house was built in 1910. It is located on .29 acre in Quincy, Florida. The house features a wrap around front porch, wood floors, picture rails, baseboards, built-in bookshelves, french doors, updated bathrooms, spacious kitchen and a built-in corner cabinet. item.title: Interesting interior! Two barns! Over four acres in Georgia. $299,900
item.description: This house has some interesting details inside! There are two barns on the property. The house was built in 1886. It is located on 4.3 acres in Fairburn, Georgia. The house features a covered front porch, a screened in back porch, carport, brick chimney, baseboards, exposed beams, bookshelves, large fireplace, vaulted ceilings and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Pretty interior! Nice kitchen! Circa 1897 in Illinois. $189,900
item.description: This house has a nice interior! I like the kitchen! The house was built in 1897. Looks more like 1875 to me. The house is located on .41 acre in Aledo, Illinois. The house features a large wrap around front porch, screened in upper porch, pretty staircase, wood floors, wide baseboards, crown moulding, bead board and an updated kitchen. The home has a newer roof and HVAC. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,304 square feet. $189,900 Contact Tanja Whitten with Ruhl & Ruhl Realtors: 309-269-2738
